_why: FR-1 collects non-Python production paths; FR-2 retires the ungated surface. U1 and U2 now guard collection. U3, U4 and U5 were removed because their guarantees asserted the retired ungated report or key itself.

mutations.name: U1: NON-PY PRODUCTION PATHS NEVER COLLECTED
mutations._mechanism: Disable non-Python production collection so a shell production path disappears.
mutations.find: current["production"].extend(token for token in _NON_PY_PATH_RE.findall(paths.group("value")) if not token.endswith(".py"))  # M:P-NONPY

mutations.name: U2: EXTENSION REQUIRED. An extensionless production path disappears.
mutations._mechanism: Require an alphabetic extension so extensionless paths are excluded from production.
